_comment: SCENE 1 timing sheet. Retime any beat by editing 'at' (ms from cutscene start). Beat names are fixed — they map to handlers in src/game/cutscene.js. Total length = 'hardcut'.

beats.name: deal
beats._: library after hours; fade in on the table + silhouette

beats.name: deal_envelope
beats._: the envelope of cash slides across the table

beats.name: deal_hands
beats._: the player's hands take the envelope

beats.name: house
beats._: cut to the dark hallway; TV murmur + bad piano upstairs; slow walk forward

beats.name: act_black
beats._: CUT TO BLACK on the moment. never shown. audio only from here

beats.name: act_chair
beats._: a chair falls over. then silence

beats.name: aftermath
beats._: fade back in. the house is silent. hold uncomfortably long

beats.name: turn
beats._: the head turns on its own. a shape at the end of the hall. it does not move

beats.name: hardcut
beats._: hard cut to the present-day library. control arrives seamlessly
